availability.meaning: availability — lease self-fence + orchestrator restart counted; recovery folded into resumeMs

completed.meaning: claim-path §1 — % of resumed programs that reached completed without outcome_unknown; outer phases (before_intent / after_call_before_journal) are the fair completion window; mid-flight phases expect unknown

stepsRepeated.meaning: claim-path §1 — completed write steps that ran again on the host (pets ledger duplicates); target 0. journal_divergence hard-stops when a stored entry no longer matches the plan (ProgramCellDO + Node durable-runner)

statePreserved.meaning: claim-path §1 — program step outcomes after resume match the no-crash baseline. Proven on Node durable-runner + kill-node stand-in via compareProgramStepStateEffect; this fleet board does not yet pair each trial with a no-crash baseline, so no rate is quoted here

waitApproval.meaning: claim-path §4 — long waits that survive crash/failover. Node plan await_approval parks while pending and resumes after settle (observe-only); density board already measures deadline restartSurvival. This fleet phased harness does not yet inject await_approval waits, so no rate is quoted here

claim: Across 100 crashes injected at every phase of a write, programs resumed on another node with no repeated writes (the 95% upper bound on the duplicate rate is 3.0%). The median resume took about 12 seconds, set by the lease timeout. Writes caught mid-flight are marked outcome unknown for a person to resolve. Under these settings, 0.0% of surviving nodes paused themselves for safety, and 0.0% of resumes missed the recovery deadline.
honesty: Two celld nodes, one object-storage provider (R2). Not durable execution / exactly-once. Columns: duplicates (safety), outcome_unknown (uncertainty), survivor self-fence/restart (availability), plus claim-path scaffolding completed + stepsRepeated + statePreserved + waitApproval (Node await_approval + density survival; fleet await trials not yet injected). Aggregate outcome_unknown ≈ half only because kills are aimed evenly at four phases — two are the in-flight window; outer phases must stay 0 (nonzero = bug). Real crashes mostly miss that brief window. Resume p50 ≈ lease TTL + detection (failover floor); raising TTL alone slows every crash. Preferred levers (planned, not measured): renew more often within the same TTL, regional lease store — see AVAILABILITY.md / TTL-TRADEOFF.md. Model-call journaling + program-level TLA+ remain open on the claim path.

lease.note: Renewals should complete with headroom ≫ R2 RTT. Stock CELLD_TTL_MS=10000 renews near ~6665ms headroom; slow renew cycles under peer-down storms can fence. See AVAILABILITY.md.
